metadataCaveat.description: The candidate sidecar retains the portrait aspect in this landscape record and differs in position/quaternion. Capture evaluation records the camera before the screenshot; a ResizeObserver timing race can leave a stale record. The actual camera used when this PNG was rendered is not reconstructed or invented. Original JSON and PNG files are preserved.

pixelEvidenceForCameraMetadataCaveat.method: Read RGB pixel arrays only; absolute channel difference; a pixel exceeds threshold if max channel difference > 10. No crop, repaint, image rewrite, camera repair, or rerender.
pixelEvidenceForCameraMetadataCaveat.interpretation: The PNG pair preserves framing closely outside the generous mouth ROI; this does not recover the actual screenshot camera or make the sidecar record exact.

visualReview.player02: Candidate .25 looks slightly fuller/less pressed, but its central dark separation and the image-right corner appear a little wider/more open. Baseline .40 reads as a tighter closed rest mouth. Neither removes the dark line.
visualReview.player04: Difference is small at phone size. Both look closed and retain a relatively full lower lip; .25 does not clearly improve corners or lip thickness.
visualReview.teethObservation: No teeth are visible in either variant in these 24 PBR images.
visualReview.blackGapLimitation: A dark PBR separation alone does not establish whether it is an actual mouth cavity or a shading effect. RAM-only material controls are separate and excluded from this report.
visualReview.recommendation: Keep the preference qualified. No automatic promotion or roster expansion is authorized by this evidence.
